reading.title: My daily routine
reading.content: On weekdays I wake up at seven and have breakfast with my family. Then I take the metro to work. I usually finish around six and go for a walk before dinner. In the evening I read for an hour and go to bed around eleven.
reading.translationUz: Hafta ichidagi kunlarda men soat yettida uyg‘onib, oilam bilan nonushta qilaman. Keyin metro bilan ishga boraman. Odatda oltida tugatib, kechki ovqatdan oldin sayrga chiqaman. Kechqurun bir soat kitob o‘qiyman va o‘n birda uxlashga yotaman.

reading.title: What's for dinner?
reading.content: Tonight we are cooking a simple pasta dish. First, boil the water with a pinch of salt. While the pasta cooks, chop some garlic and tomatoes for the sauce. In ten minutes, drain the pasta and mix everything together. Serve with grated cheese on top.
reading.translationUz: Bugun kechqurun oddiy makaron tayyorlaymiz. Avval bir chimdim tuz bilan suvni qaynatamiz. Makaron qaynayotganda, sous uchun sarimsoq va pomidorni to‘g‘raymiz. O‘n daqiqadan so‘ng makaronni suvdan oling va hammasini aralashtiring. Ustiga maydalangan pishloq sepib tortib boring.

reading.title: My small kitchen
reading.content: My kitchen is small but useful. On the left there is a fridge and next to it the stove. The counter has a kettle and a toaster. I keep the plates in the cupboard above the sink. It is enough space for one person who cooks simple meals.
reading.translationUz: Oshxonam kichik, lekin qulay. Chapda muzlatgich, uning yonida pechka turibdi. Peshtaxtada choynak va toster bor. Likobchalarni idish yuvish joyining yuqorisidagi shkafda saqlayman. Oddiy ovqatlar pishiradigan bir kishi uchun yetarli.

reading.title: Weekend at home
reading.content: On Saturday mornings I clean the apartment and do the laundry. In the afternoon I usually meet a friend for coffee. On Sunday I prefer to stay in, read a book, and cook a bigger meal. By the evening I am ready for the week again.
reading.translationUz: Shanba kuni ertalab kvartirani tozalayman va kir yuvaman. Tushdan keyin odatda do‘stim bilan qahva uchun uchrashaman. Yakshanbada uyda qolib, kitob o‘qib, kattaroq ovqat pishirishni afzal ko‘raman. Oqshomga qadar hafta uchun yana tayyor bo‘laman.

reading.title: Learning to cook
reading.content: When I lived alone for the first time, I had to learn how to cook. I started with simple dishes like scrambled eggs and pasta. After a few months I could follow longer recipes. Now I enjoy inviting friends over and cooking something new every weekend.
reading.translationUz: Ilk bor yolg‘iz yashay boshlaganimda, ovqat pishirishni o‘rganishga to‘g‘ri keldi. Oddiy taomlar — qovurilgan tuxum va makaron bilan boshladim. Bir necha oydan so‘ng uzunroq retseptlarga amal qila oldim. Hozir do‘stlarni uyga chaqirib, har dam olish kuni yangi narsa pishirishni yoqtiraman.
